name: Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbone
summary: At the Angerfang Encampment, renegade Dragonmaw orcs provide sturdy shinbones for armor. In the Undercity, Velora Nitely needs them to frame leg guards for warriors.

sections.title: Bones for the Frame
sections.body: Velora Nitely needs bones that can bear the strain of brutal leg guards. The renegade Dragonmaw orcs at the Angerfang Encampment in the central Wetlands have thick, sturdy frames, and their shinbones can brace the armor. Each bone must be tested by hand. Warriors discard any that snap under pressure.

faq.q: What makes these shinbones sturdy compared to normal ones?
faq.answer: Dragonmaw orcs have thick skeletal frames, but fractures can make a bone too brittle for armor. A warrior bends each shinbone by hand and keeps only those that resist breaking.
Velora Nitely, an armorer in the Undercity, wants Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones. She uses them as framing struts for brutal leg guards made for promising Horde warriors.
The bones come from renegade Dragonmaw orcs in the Wetlands, south of the Arathi Highlands. They are found especially at the Angerfang Encampment in the hills southwest of the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Why does Velora Nitely use orc bones for armor?
faq.answer: Forsaken smiths use bone, sinew, and metal to make durable wargear. The Dragonmaw clan is hostile to Thrall's Horde, so Forsaken smiths use their remains as resilient crafting material.

angles.text: As a warrior, you test dense orc bones by hand and gather pieces to frame custom armor. This shows your physical might.
As an undead, you can see Forsaken pragmatism in Velora Nitely's use of enemy bones for equipment for the Dark Lady's champions.
